name: Court no Naka no Tenshi-tachi
source:
Two sisters manage to get our guy out of his depression of past glories to train his girls volleyball team. In mode 1, he has no choice but to use the girls for revenge against the volleyball league. But in mode 2, if he can complete mode 1, he can find a girl to love.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
